description: Permanently delete a non-key field from an entity type. Irreversible destructive schema mutation: removes the column definition and its stored values across all existing rows; requires administrative permissions. System/primary key fields cannot be deleted. Use `get_table` first to verify the field name, `add_field` to add columns, or `delete_rows` to delete records instead of columns. Returns confirmation of the deleted field.

fieldName.description: System name of the non-key field to permanently delete (required).

name: delete_field
